description: This file defines the 'Surface' class within the 'wayland' namespace, which manages Wayland surface buffers, regions, and related metadata. It includes methods for attaching buffers, setting regions, committing frame states, and setting scanout IDs, and maintains internal state with thread safety.

classes.name: Surface
classes.description: Represents a Wayland surface, managing its buffers, regions, and associated metadata.

methods.name: SetRegion
methods.description: Sets the display region for the surface.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to the surface for the next frame.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits the pending buffer and state changes.

methods.name: SetVirtioGpuScanoutId
methods.description: Sets the scanout ID for Virtio GPU.
